privacy.title: Privacy Policy

sections.heading: 1. Information We Collect
sections.body: When a business registers we collect the owner's name, phone number, email and business details. When you make a booking we collect your name and phone number (normalized to +2519xxxxxxxx), plus an optional email address. Your consumer profile is keyed by phone.

sections.heading: 2. Telegram Messaging Consent
sections.body: You opt in to Telegram messages by tapping "ማስታወሻ በ Telegram" on your booking confirmation and pressing Start in our bot — that tap records your consent with a timestamp. We then send booking confirmations and reminders to that chat. The bot can never message you first; every flow starts from you. Withdraw anytime by blocking the bot — that stops all Telegram traffic from us.

sections.heading: 3. Marketing Consent
sections.body: Businesses may only send you promotions if you ticked the marketing-consent box at booking time or opted in through their customer list. The consent moment is timestamped. To stop marketing messages, opt out directly with the business.

sections.heading: 4. Loyalty Tracking & Data Use
sections.body: Your completed visits are counted per business, keyed by phone, to power punch-card rewards. Your data is stored securely and is never sold for marketing.

sections.heading: 5. Data Deletion Rights
sections.body: You may request deletion of your data at any time via POST /api/consumer/data-deletion (or by emailing support@egebeya.et). Requests are logged and acknowledged immediately, and fulfilled within 30 days.

sections.heading: 6. Service Providers
sections.body: We share data only with the processors who run the service for us, each limited to its purpose: Chapa (payment processing — when a business pays for a subscription, Chapa receives the owner's name, email and phone number), Ethio Telecom (hosting infrastructure), Google Gemini (generating business descriptions from the name, category and services you enter), and OpenRouter with Claude (the AI assistant inside the website builder, which processes your existing site content when you use it). None of these providers may use your data for their own purposes.

sections.heading: 7. Data Retention
sections.body: Identity data is kept only while your account is active. When deletion is fulfilled (within 30 days of your request), identity fields are erased and booking records are anonymized. Payment and invoice records are retained where Ethiopian accounting law requires, but with identity fields removed. Loyalty records are destroyed together with your data.

sections.heading: 8. International Data Transfers
sections.body: Your data may be processed by the processors above outside Ethiopia. We rely on each processor's data-protection commitments when data leaves Ethiopia.

sections.heading: 9. California Privacy Rights
sections.body: If you are a California resident, you have the right to know, correct, and delete your personal information. We do not sell or share personal information as those terms are defined by the CCPA/CPRA, so no "Do Not Sell or Share" link is required. If our practices ever change, we will update this policy and honor Global Privacy Control opt-out signals before any sale or sharing begins.

sections.heading: 10. Who This Policy Covers
sections.body: Egebeya is directed to users in Ethiopia. If you use the service from the European Union, the United Kingdom, or the United States, the rights in this policy apply to you regardless of your location.

privacy.contactBody: Questions about this policy? Reach us at

terms.title: Terms of Service

sections.heading: 1. Acceptance of Terms
sections.body: By registering for and using Egebeya you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, you may not use the service.

sections.heading: 2. Description of Service
sections.body: Egebeya provides an online booking platform connecting customers with service businesses. We facilitate bookings and payments but are not a party to the service agreement between businesses and customers.

sections.heading: 3. User Obligations
sections.body: You agree to provide accurate information, keep your credentials confidential, and use the service in compliance with applicable laws.

sections.heading: 4. Consumer Accounts & Telegram
sections.body: Consumer accounts are keyed by phone; login codes arrive over Telegram after you opt in via "ማስታወሻ በ Telegram". You may withdraw messaging consent at any time.

sections.heading: 5. Loyalty Rewards
sections.body: Punch-card rewards are merchant-funded: a reward equals a discount applied to a future booking payment, never cash.

sections.heading: 6. Limitation of Liability
sections.body: Egebeya shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from use of the service.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Statement
accessibility.basis: Published under the EU Accessibility Act microenterprise exemption

sections.heading: 1. Scope
sections.body: This statement covers egebeya.et and the customer-facing booking flows it hosts for businesses (service selection, booking, and the Discover directory). Accessibility is how we make sure every customer — including those using screen readers, larger text, or keyboard-only navigation — can find and book a business.

sections.heading: 2. Our standard
sections.body: We aim to meet WCAG 2.1 Level AA, the standard referenced by EN 301 549 (the European harmonised accessibility standard). We design touch-first for small Android phones on slow connections, and we keep the customer-facing booking flow reachable without an account.

sections.heading: 3. How we are doing
sections.body: We are partially conformant: most of the customer-facing flows meet the standard, and we are working through the remainder. Known areas we are improving: some interactive controls in the website builder are not yet fully labelled for screen readers (the builder is the owner's tool; the public booking flow is prioritised).

sections.heading: 4. Basis for limited obligations
sections.body: Egebeya is a microenterprise under Article 4(5) of Directive (EU) 2019/882 (fewer than 10 employees and turnover or balance sheet not exceeding €2 million), so the directive's accessibility obligations do not currently apply to our services. We publish this statement anyway and keep working on accessibility as good practice. If we grow past those thresholds, we will re-assess and update this statement.

sections.heading: 5. Tell us about a barrier
sections.body: If you hit a barrier using egebeya — anything you cannot read, reach, or operate — tell us and we will fix it. We treat accessibility reports as priority feedback, not support tickets.
